sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 27 = check 26; Internal Quality Checks row 27 annotation: flows may combine several verifiers)
.qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (file list; instruction/judge layout compared by listing only)
.qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml (all 152 criterion descriptions; the first ~700 characters of each, full text for the D/L/intent-key rows)
evidence: Source-only review; no runtime run was used and none is claimed. I built a requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md sections 1-12 against 152 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual and 2 gate criteria. Coverage is otherwise broad: composition/bands, tier matrix, dual control, budget gates, revision/rescission settlement, vesting calendars, referral clocks, audit lines and after-images, restart, anonymous 401s, coordinated netting, lineage, ABA freshness, idempotent retry (later and after restart), concurrency, what-if for other roles, add/remove members, field-level refusal, unsent entries, session resume, focus and live arrival all have owners. Two stated behaviours have no owning criterion. GAP 1: hireops_rules.md:522-525 requires the live out-of-date mark to follow 'the same test commit applies', 'including one made and then reversed', and 'The events section 11 lists as not invalidating a preview do not mark it either'. The only criterion on the mark, hro_live_stale_mark (functional/judge.toml:1334), grades arrival after one approval and explicitly disclaims correctness: 'Whether this app's freshness test is correct, including the restored-balance and non-invalidating cases, belongs to hro_change_aba and hro_change_noninvalidating and must not be charged here.' Those two rows (judge.toml:1023 and 1032 blocks) grade the commit result (409 / still committable), not what the desk displays. So the displayed classification after a restored balance, and after a non-invalidating event, is graded nowhere. GAP 2: hireops_rules.md:460-461 says 'Commit uses the saved intent and recomputes/validates stored facts; values or identities in a request cannot override that intent or the signed-in actor.' functional/prompt.md:67 (B3) tells the judge to 'Try ordinary commit replays that change any supplied saved identity/economic values', but no criterion description contains that bar: hro_change_intent_key (judge.toml:1041) covers only key reuse on prepare and non-refresh of a stale preview, and a search of the functional and polish judge.toml for 'authoritative', 'saved intent', 'stored intent' and 'commit replay' finds only the B5 prepare-403 rows. The prompt also tells the judge to check each criterion's feature and nothing else (prompt.md:9), so the observation has no place to score. Not counted as gaps: actor/key isolation between two Finance users (one Finance account supplied; prompt.md:71 says so), GET /api/health not touching the database, no outside data service and no package installs (not observable by a browser judge), and several rules sharing one flow criterion (known false positive for this check). Raw-evidence-index.json was not relied on.
counterexample: (1) An app whose desk marks a saved preview out of date by comparing current headroom with the headroom captured at preview. It marks the preview after the extra approval (hro_live_stale_mark passes), then shows it as current again once Finance rescinds the extra hire, while commit still returns 409 (hro_change_aba passes). The desk tells Finance the preview is current when it is not, contrary to rules lines 522-525 and instruction.md line 3 and line 9, and loses no credit. The mirror app that marks every preview out of date on any books change, including a pending offer creation, also loses no credit. (2) An app whose commit endpoint accepts member terms or destinations in the request body and settles those instead of the saved preview. Every UI-driven commit sends matching values, so all B criteria pass; the override forbidden by rules line 460-461 is never charged to any criterion.
suggested_fix: Give each gap an owner without adding new public requirements: add one functional criterion (or extend hro_live_stale_mark and remove its disclaimer) requiring that the open desk still shows the preview as out of date after the balance is restored and shows a preview as current after a pending creation on a touched requisition; and add the commit-override bar to a criterion (a new one or hro_change_intent_key) so the B3 replay already scripted at prompt.md:67 is scored. Rebalance weights and recheck judge workload in the same candidate.
